root_causes.root_cause: The incremental ingest+score pipeline (corpus-ingest-score.js) lacks retry logic in its Stage 2 (fetch metrics) when reading MinIO artifacts. The minio_helper.py script has zero retry on S3 NoSuchKey or transient network errors. When a transient MinIO read failure occurs between Stage 1 (process) completing and Stage 2 (fetch) reading, the document gets a permanent ERROR verdict despite the artifacts existing in MinIO. The converter child writes synchronously (save_doc then save_doc_meta via put_object) before emitting its success JSON, so the write IS committed before Stage 1 reports success. The gap is in the read path: minio_helper.py cmd_meta and cmd_tree make single-attempt reads with no retry-with-backoff, and the Stage 2 agent prompt contains no instruction to retry on failure.
root_causes.suggested_fix: Add retry-with-backoff (3 attempts, 2s/4s/8s delays) to minio_helper.py cmd_meta and cmd_tree for transient S3 errors (NoSuchKey, ConnectionError, network timeouts). Additionally, add a retry instruction to the Stage 2 agent prompt in corpus-ingest-score.js: 'If minio_helper.py returns NoSuchKey, wait 5 seconds and retry up to 3 times before concluding the artifacts are missing.'
